howItWorks.title: How DogBreedID Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From image upload to AI prediction in three seamless steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Choose a clear dog image from your computer or mobile device.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The CNN extracts visual features such as facial contours, ears, coat patterns, and body proportions.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Review predicted breed class, confidence percentage, and similar probabilities with Grad-CAM insights.

features.feat2Desc: Provides calibrated confidence metrics based on Softmax classification probabilities.
features.feat3Desc: Displays visually similar alternative breed classes to assist in close classification decisions.
features.feat4Desc: Visualizes spatial activation maps showing feature regions that influenced the model prediction.
